svg.aria-label: Rung 10, deployed today: visitors reach CloudFront for the single-page app or one App Runner instance per service; that instance holds sessions and rate limits in its own process memory and reads an Aurora Serverless v2 database that pauses when idle, while the language model is never called because chat answers are replayed from a recorded pack.

g.title: visitors — no login on any of the three demos, so every arrival is anonymous
CloudFront — the static React bundle, Data Pilot only; the other two serve their UI from the same container as the API
App Runner — front door and compute in one managed service, pinned to a single instance per service (min_size = max_size = 1, max_concurrency 100)
Aurora Serverless v2 — 0 to 1 ACU, so it pauses when idle; the first visitor after a pause waits about 30 seconds, narrated in the UI. Data Pilot only.
session and rate-limit state — kept in process memory, which is correct at exactly one instance and is the named seam beyond it
the language model — not called on the public URL; chat replays recorded runs, so the worst-case bill is a fixed ceiling instead of an unbounded one
